name: mongodb-servertimeout-vs-waitqueue
hook: serverSelectionTimeoutMS and waitQueueTimeoutMS have different failure modes
body: serverSelectionTimeoutMS controls how long to wait when NO server is available (fails fast when DB is down). waitQueueTimeoutMS controls how long a request waits for a connection from the pool (causes MongoWaitQueueTimeoutError during pool exhaustion). Only waitQueueTimeoutMS causes MongoWaitQueueTimeoutError during cold starts.
why: Prevented correct fix from being applied - serverSelectionTimeoutMS was incorrectly blocked along with waitQueueTimeoutMS
